description: Iceberg SQL catalog (CATALOG_TYPE 'sql') stored in a SQLite database, attached through the sqlite_scanner extension. Requires no service or network.
on_init: ATTACH '{TEMP_DIR}/iceberg_sql_warehouse' AS my_datalake (TYPE ICEBERG, CATALOG_TYPE 'sql', URI 'sqlite:///{TEMP_DIR}/iceberg_sql_catalog.db'); CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS my_datalake.default;
